scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('coverage',{recursive:true})" && cargo llvm-cov --package customer-rust-core --fail-under-lines 80 --json --summary-only --output-path coverage/llvm-cov.json && node scripts/coverage-summary.mjs
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --exclude customer-rust-app --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p customer-rust-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings

coverage.measured: core (crate customer-rust-core), 80% lines, cargo llvm-cov (spec 040 research R11)
coverage.excluded: app (crate customer-rust-app): Leptos views and browser glue compiled only to WebAssembly, which cargo llvm-cov cannot measure natively. Constitution VI's replacement control (3.12.0): every @customer journey runs against it in the customer-rust Playwright project, plus spec 040's own journeys (040 S1, S2, S5, S6, S8, S11).
